reason: I check Google and Trustpilot before I contact anyone, and there's nothing to check here: no UK clients, no reviews, and the one real project is anonymous and in Kuwait. Pay-when-happy is nice, but I'd still be giving up hours to calls, scoping and two rounds of changes with someone I can't vet.
objection: Zero reviews I can read, and it sounds like a lot of back-and-forth over WhatsApp and video calls with someone in a different time zone when I don't have time for that.
would_change_my_mind: A handful of real Google or Trustpilot reviews from UK small businesses, ideally Manchester, plus a process where I fill in a short form instead of doing calls.
